name: TCS-1205
summary: TCS 1205 is a GABAA receptor positive allosteric modulator of the tryptamine family. It is a benzodiazepine site agonist selective for certain subunits.

pharmacology.text: TCS 1205 acts at the benzodiazepine binding site, it is selective for the α1 and α2 subunits of the GABAA receptor. In vivo, it has anxiolytic effects but no sedative effects.

uses.en: It is a research compound used to study GABA-A receptor subtypes.
uses.zh: 它是用來研究GABA-A受體亞型的研究用化合物。
uses.zhHans: 它是用来研究GABA-A受体亚型的研究用化合物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs acting at the benzodiazepine site can cause drowsiness, poor coordination and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。作用於苯二氮平結合位的藥物可能造成嗜睡、協調變差與依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。作用于苯二氮平结合位的药物可能造成嗜睡、协调制差与依赖。

fact.en: In animals it reduced anxiety without causing sedation, a goal that drug makers have chased for decades by targeting particular GABA-A receptor subtypes.
fact.zh: 在動物實驗中，它能減輕焦慮卻不造成鎮靜，而這正是藥廠數十年來試圖透過針對特定GABA-A受體亞型所追求的目標。
fact.zhHans: 在动物实验中，它能减轻焦虑却不造成镇静，而这正是药厂数十年来试图通过针对特定GABA-A受体亚型所追求的目标。
